climate: A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A small AVA of about 32,000 acres in Pecos County, in the Trans-Pecos region of west Texas. It had one winery, with about 250 acres of vines. That winery went bankrupt in 2022, and its vineyards were abandoned.
